question: Who among the following received the Sahitya Akademi Award (Non-fiction) for his book ‘An Era of Darkness’ in 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shashi Tharoor**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shashi Tharoor**

 
 
• **Shashi Tharoor, an Indian politician, author, and member of the Congress party** has won the **Sahitya Akademi Award for 2019**.
 
• The honourable prize was given to the **Lok Sabha member from Thiruvananthapuram for his book' An Era of Darkness: The British Empire in India.'**
 
• In **2016**, the book was released.
 
• The **Sahitya Akademi published a press release in 23 languages on December 18, 2019**, announcing the winners of the annual Sahitya Akademi Awards.
 
• One of the **list's winners was Shashi Tharoor**.
 
• He received the award for **his English-language creative non-fiction work**.
 
• The impact of **British colonial rule in India and how the colonists abused the nation** are discussed in **Shashi Tharoor's book**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Shashi Tharoor has also held the **positions of Minister of State for External Affairs and Under-Secretary General for Communications and Public Information at the UN**.
 
• He is well-known for having a **perfect command of the English language** and for having a vocabulary that went viral online.
 
• Since 1981, **Tharoor has written 23 books, both fiction and nonfiction**, with a focus on** India and its history, culture, film, politics, society, and other relevant topics**.
 
• He was **born in London** and **earned his degree from Delhi's St. Stephen's College in 1975**.
 
• He earned his** doctorate in international relations and affairs from the Tufts University Fletcher School of Law and Diplomacy in 1978**.
